values.note: Reservations open in January for the April-November season. Two-night minimum on Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day and Columbus Day. At most 14 reserved nights in any 30 days; stays may be extended day to day up to 21 nights. No monthly or long-term stays. Campers without a reservation are taken first come, first served.

values.note: RV site $40 a night May 1-September 30, $35 in April and October-November; weekly $240 / $210. Fees cover 4 people and the RV plus one vehicle or trailer. No resident/non-resident split.
